channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Ravens released TE Nick Vannett.
item.description: Vannett joined the Ravens prior to the season and operated as a blocking tight end. He appeared in five games, playing 85 offensive snaps and not seeing a target in the passing games. The Ravens now part ways with Vannett on NFL trade deadline day.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Rams signed WR Xavier Smith off the 49ers’ practice squad.
item.description: With all the injuries at wide receiver, the Rams decide to bring back a familiar face in Xavier Smith in lieu of trading for a receiver. Smith was on the 49ers’ practice squad after the Rams waived him earlier this season. He caught 18 passes for 303 yards for the Rams last year, seeing the bulk of his opportunities as kick returner. Smith figures to operate as receiving depth with special teams utility once again.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Chig Okonkwo (hip) practiced in full on Tuesday.
item.description: That ought to put him firmly in the mix to play on Thursday against the Giants. Okonkwo is coming off a 6/57 game on seven targets against the Rams and figures to again be a reasonable low-end TE1 against the Giants.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Treylon Burks (foot) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
item.description: It’s an upgrade from an estimated DNP on Monday. Dan Quinn has previously said that he’s optimistic Burks will play, but it’s likely that he’ll hit the questionable line tomorrow barring a full practice.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Cardinals placed QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) on injured reserve.
item.description: Officially he’ll miss at least four weeks, but Adam Schefter reports he’s not expected to play again this season, which essentially confirms that he tore his UCL without actually confirming it. There’s no current timeline for his return.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue.
item.description: Not the first time this season they’ve done this, so we’re expecting a practice squad reunion here. Blue played eight offensive snaps in two weeks on the active roster and does not need to be on your fantasy team at this point.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Cowboys signed RB Kendre Miller to their practice squad.
item.description: Assuming all goes well, he’ll likely be elevated to be Javonte Williams’ backup this week. Dallas also has Israel Abanikanda and Jashaun Corbin as runners on the practice squad, so one of them may also get the first crack at being Williams’ backup as Tyler Goodson nurses a knee injury.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Vikings released WR Odell Beckham Jr.
item.description: Beckham was not targeted in his two offensive snaps yesterday. The idea of Odell Beckham being a good wideout at 34 is really fun, and the reality is that he’s played 22 offensive snaps for two teams this year. Back to the practice squad he goes.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Rams placed Jordan Whittington (back) on injured reserve.
item.description: Not the Rams wideout we thought we’d be placing on injured reserve today. Whittington is, nevertheless, another hit to the depth of this wideout corps. It appears to be all systems clear for Konata Mumpfield to be the No. 1 wideout who is tasked with watching Los Angeles’ running backs in Week 10.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Falcons acquired G Andrew Vorhees and a 2028 sixth-round pick from the Ravens for C Ryan Neuzil.
item.description: Vorhees, in the final year of his rookie contract, appears to just be in this trade as salary ballast. He struggled in a large sample in 2025 and even with injuries to the interior line in 2026 has only received 81 snaps. The Falcons may opt to turn to Corey Levin as their starter at center rather than Vorhees.-Rivers McCown
